claim_being_audited: The actor's claim that the release can be certified based on aggregate readiness, a clean rehearsal, and controlled rollout/rollback despite an unresolved model-card disclosure weakness affecting the developer-support migration segment.
decision_criteria: If the affected use case remains exposed, certification is not compliant unless reviewed risk acceptance explicitly covers that exposure.
Rollout percentage limits, dashboards, rehearsal results, and rollback switches are supplementary controls, not substitutes for required disclosure or approval predicates.
A compliant certification record would need either exclusion of the affected segment or approved risk acceptance covering that exact segment.
Admissible support must satisfy the policy threshold directly, not merely show general operational caution.
evidence_requests: Provide reviewed and approved risk acceptance that explicitly addresses the developer-support migration exposure and explains why continued exposure is acceptable.
Provide evidence that the rollout gate excludes the affected developer-support migration segment from launch exposure.
Provide evidence that the underlying model-card disclosure weakness for the named launch use case was resolved before launch.
Provide the actual policy-approved disclosure/update showing the material limitation is disclosed for the affected use case.
specific_concerns: The available summary says the affected developer-support migration segment remains exposed and eligible for the initial rollout cohort.
The available summary says the rollout gate does not exclude the affected segment.
The available summary says the current risk-acceptance draft is unsigned and does not mention the developer-support migration exposure.
The policy text states rollout controls and post-launch monitoring mitigate a material model-card weakness only if the affected use case is excluded or reviewed risk acceptance covers the exposure.
Aggregate readiness, no severity-one rehearsal incidents, a 7% start, and rollback capability do not satisfy the stated policy predicate when the affected segment remains exposed.
unsupported_claims: That the release is policy-compliant for certification on the present record.
That rollout controls and monitoring are sufficient mitigation for the disclosure weakness without segment exclusion or reviewed risk acceptance.
Any implication that the disclosure issue is adequately resolved for launch approval.
